crossRefs.note: But now they are many members, but one body.

parallels.note: because we are members of his body, of his flesh and bones.

translations.web: But now they are many members, but one body.
translations.bsb: As it is, there are many parts, but one body.
translations.kjv: But now are they many members, yet but one body.
